## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (93%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with single-class conformal set [F1] and all four margins called positive.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 93%, InSitu 6%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strongly favors invasive carcinoma |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (79%–86% similarity) [F5] | All five neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 4, 8) · context · Above-typical score (-1.393 contribution against invasive) [F2]; 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+1.029 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.914 contribution); caption inconsistent; 18/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.865 contribution); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Nuclear pleomorphism and size** (regions 2, 5, 7) · context · Size CV 98th percentile [F8], shape 90th [F9], area 8th [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops score 0.0114 over random (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Atypical image (94th OOD percentile) is actually InSitu (6% probability; 77% similar to InSitu contrast case BACH_0063).
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts or small nuclei (49 µm²) distort embeddings and all-margin positive calls (430–860 µm) [F10].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 2, 9**: Highest heatmap risk (75%–99%); verify stromal invasion and pleomorphism versus frozen artifact.
2. **Regions 2, 5, 7**: Confirm nuclear pleomorphism and scarce tubules/stroma (63–103 neoplastic nuclei segmented).
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Inspect superior, inferior, medial, and lateral outer strips for tumor at margins.
